Welcome to Graduate Studies

As a public institution with its roots in western Nebraska, Chadron State College takes pride in its affordability and accessibility. The institution offers advanced education and preparation through its Graduate degree programs, all for an affordable price.

Chadron State College is regionally accredited by the Higher Learning Commission, as well as other specialized accreditations.

In addition to the degree programs listed below, Chadron State College offers graduate certificates in Digital Marketing and Healthcare Management and graduate level online Professional Development courses for educators.

Welcome to Chadron State College, Graduate Studies. Whether you are a prospective student, a current student, a faculty member, or a community member, we are delighted to have you here.

Chadron State College is committed to fostering an environment of academic excellence, innovation, and inclusivity. Our institution prides itself on providing exceptional education that prepares students for success in their chosen fields. We strive to cultivate a diverse and vibrant learning community, where every individual is valued and supported in their educational journey. Our dedicated faculty members are passionate about teaching and research, and they bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the classroom. We believe in providing a well-rounded education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical skills, enabling our students to make a positive impact in their professions and society.

Admissions at 1-800-CHADRON (800-242-3766) or graduateadmissions@csc.edu
